hints.title: Day Multiplier Invariant
hints.text: Since the multiplier d increases monotonically from 1 to m * n, smaller values should be multiplied by earlier days and larger values by later days.

hints.title: Row Suffix Accessibility
hints.text: Because each row is sorted non-increasingly, the current minimum remaining element across all rows is always accessible at the rightmost position of some row.

hints.title: Global Greedy Sorting
hints.text: Collect all m * n values into a single array, sort in ascending order, and multiply value at rank d by day d.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Flattening and sorting all elements across shops.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating day-by-day search without global sorting is slower and unnecessary.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m * n) storage for flattened array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce from rearrangement inequality that overall ascending order is always legally achievable.
